verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a set of Claude Code skill files plus local, network-free Python scripts. It runs inside a chat or agent and exposes no API of its own, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec for the product is a category error. Its feature of planning an API for the user's clone is a different capability, and no evidence says it produces an OpenAPI file, so it does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
